_comment: Checked against the held-out `test` split only. `dev` is the only data tuning may look at; gating on dev would measure memorisation. Each bound sits just below the last measured value, so it fails on a regression rather than on noise.
_known_gaps: privacy: a ticket id shaped like a phone number (415-555-0132-A) still false-alarms
privacy: driver's licence numbers have no pattern
factuality/evidence: bag-of-word overlap cannot tell an added attribution ('approved by the board') from a paraphrase; judge.entails is the upgrade path
factuality/heuristic: with no judge model configured this branch cannot detect a false statement that reads like a true one, and is capped at 0.55 so it can never block on its own
